question.text: An equimolar mixture of toluene and chlorobenzene is treated with a mixture of conc. $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{SO}_{4}$ and conc. $\mathrm{HNO}_{3}$. Indicate the correct statement from the following.

options.text: equimolar amounts of $p$ -nitrotoluene and p-nitrochlorobenzene are formed

solution.text: As toluene and chlorobenzene, both can react with mixture of conc. $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{SO}_{4}$ and conc. HNO $_{3}$. but being more reactive, toluene will yield p-nitrotoluene in excess.
